protocol.preflight: Validate required input, target artifact, stage, and access before output.
protocol.checkpoint: Before material questions, edits, validation, retries, or handoff, save stage, run state, last action, resume reference, and exactly one next action in the command's state record.
protocol.resume: Resume paused work when prerequisites hold; ask one interactive material resume question when the saved state is stopped or ambiguous.
protocol.blocked: Record the material blocker and continuation condition; retry only when that condition changes or the user directs it.
protocol.closure: Report artifact, outcome, blocker if any, and exactly one registered next action.
